'''Bingo Talisman''' is a {{Common}} [[Accessory]], purchasable from {{NPCSprite|Bingo}}.

== Obtaining ==
'''Bingo Talisman''' can be purchased from {{BingoText|shop}} for {{Bingo Points|100}} once the player has reached {{BingoText|1}}.

== Usage ==
{{Item|Bingo Ring}} can be bought from {{BingoText|shop}} with {{Green|1x}} {{Item|Bingo Talisman}} and {{Bingo Points|150}} once the player has reached {{BingoText|2}}.

== Trivia ==
* It is one of the three accessories in the game that grants no buff, alongside the {{Item|Hegemony Artifact}} and {{Item|Hocus-Pocus Cipher}} (outside of the rift). It only grants buffs via [[Accessory Power]]
*The lore of the item is a reference to the children's song [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9mmF8zOlh_g BINGO], where the letters of the word are sung to spell out the name of a farmer's dog.
**Furthermore, when playing the game Bingo, columns are often distinguished by those letters as opposed to A, B, C...
